review_description: The sales process frrom all companies that i asked to quote was professional. Installation was done at the time/day promised by a very competent team. Customer service was  good and being local I could speak to the same person whenever I needed extra information or a slight change of plans (eg adding a battery ready inverter just in case we want to add a battery later)

Installer listened to what I needed and quoted accordingly. I already had an Enphase system and wanted to add more panels. It took less than 2 weeks from the initial point of contact to the system being fully installed. The owner of the company took on the responsibility of tweaking some teething issues with the Enphase Envoy monitor. All staff were polite and tidy. I opulent ask for a better outcome. Thanks Team.
A great company to deal with and the installer is actually the guy who owns the company.....
